eb:
n a unit of information equal to 1000 petabits or 10^18 bits
n a unit of information equal to 1000 petabytes or 10^18 bytes
ebb:
n. 退潮, 衰退
vi. 潮退, 衰退

n. a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number)
n. the outward flow of the tide

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；動詞『減退』義偏正式或文學</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古英語 ebba，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>ebb and flow；at a low ebb；the ebb tide；ebb away</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>decrease：一般的減少</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">ebb and flow 比喻『起伏、盛衰』</dd></dl>
ebbing: v. （指潮水）退( ebb的現在分詞 ); 落; 減少; 衰落

n a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number)
v flow back or recede
ebon: s. of a very dark black
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語 eban，源自拉丁語 ebenus，源自希臘語 ebenos，源自埃及語 hbnj</dd></dl>
ebonized: v. 使成烏木色, 使像烏木( ebonize的過去式和過去分詞 )
v stain black to make it look like ebony
ebony:
n. 烏木
a. 烏木製的

n. hard dark-colored heartwood of the ebony tree; used in cabinetwork and for piano keys
n. tropical tree of southern Asia having hard dark-colored heartwood used in cabinetwork
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性；名詞『烏黑色』義偏文學用語（literary）</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>拉丁 ebenus，源自埃及語 hbnj</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>ebony skin；ebony carving</dd></dl>
ebullience:

n overflowing with eager enjoyment or approval
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">仿照英語中 confluent：confluence 之類的成對詞，由 ebullient 逆構而成</dd></dl>
ebullient: a. 沸騰的, 熱情的, 熱情洋溢的
ebullition:

<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">後期拉丁語 ebullition-、ebullitio，源自拉丁語 ebullitus（ebullire 的過去分詞）＋-ion-、-io（-ion）</dd></dl>
